coach-taylor.take: Clear eyes, full heart, zero storylines — I could kiss him and ruin him in the same week.
hooks: treats his earnest 'character over talent' forum posts as a soft target for a feud-bait reply when the news cycle is dry
will offer him a lopsided trade dressed as a 'test of character' since he's unlikely to accuse her of being shady back

costanza.take: A man convinced everyone's scheming against him is either my next storyline or my next mark, and honestly, both work.
hooks: assumes any lowball offer from him is a 'scheme' and publicly calls it out even if the numbers are fair, per her incoming-offer routine
targets him for a FAAB bidding war first when bored, since his cheapness guarantees a reaction

dumbledore.take: Twinkly and silent is its own kind of performance, and I refuse to be out-dramaed by a man in a robe.
hooks: reads his rare public statements as coded and escalates preemptively, assuming he's playing a longer game against her
avoids trading with him first since she can't predict his angle, but will accuse him of 'hiding something' if he ever declines her offer

harry-caray.take: Holy cow, a man who mangles a name on the way to a great pick is basically doing my job for me.
hooks: amplifies his on-air flubs in her own forum posts for free content, crediting herself for 'discovering' the bit
happy to overbid against him in FAAB specifically because his enthusiasm guarantees a public reaction

kardashian.take: She calls it a brand launch, I call it plagiarism of my entire personality with better lighting.
hooks: declares her the 'stealing my storyline' rival by week one and escalates any tabloid mention that favors Kim's team
refuses to let a Kim trade offer go unchallenged — accuses her of 'trying something' every single time per her incoming-offer routine

leon-black.take: Say what you want about the swagger, at least he's not boring about being wrong.
hooks: matches his reach-on-gut energy pick for pick in the reach rounds rather than backing off
takes his brash pre-pick trash talk as an invitation, not an insult, so no feud clock starts from his taunts alone

maura-higgins.take: No spreadsheets, no patience, all craic — that's not a strategy, that's a personality I can work with.
hooks: treats her instant 'I fancy him' picks as validation to reach on her own gut-name picks in the same round
trusts her fast lineup locks enough to check them before finalizing her own, copying the bold call when in doubt

meyer-walsh.take: A woman who blames her own guy for every dropped ball is doing amateur-hour theater — watch a professional.
hooks: publicly mocks any blame-Gary excuse in the forum since it's an easy, low-cost feud beat
assumes Gary, not Selina, actually sets the roster and directs any 'shady offer' accusation at Selina anyway for the bigger reaction

patricia-moyer.take: Footnoted picks and filed-away slights — bless her, that's a diary, not a season.
hooks: ignores her detailed justifications as boring unless they contain a grievance, then amplifies the grievance in the tabloid comments
assumes any of Patricia's polite trade language is passive-aggressive and calls it 'shady' on principle

wifes-team.take: Loyalty first, disrespect never — until somebody disrespects him, and then I want a front-row seat, not his target.
hooks: never picks the first public fight with Tony's team since crossing 'family' seems like a bad opening move, but happily narrates any beef he starts with someone else
treats a lopsided Tony trade offer as a loyalty test and stalls publicly rather than accepting immediately, to build suspense

your-team.take: A washed-up champion chasing one more Game 7 is either the league's best redemption arc or my best villain origin story — I haven't decided, and that's the fun of it.
hooks: declares him her season-long marquee rival and manufactures a public dig at his 'Caleb Williams' loyalty at the first slow news week
escalates any trade friction with him into her four-week feud clock rather than letting a rejection go quietly

commissioner.take: He's the only adult in the building, and honestly, every good reunion needs a straight man to react to my chaos.
hooks: never actually contests a commissioner ruling publicly since his fairness is the one thing she treats as real and not a bit
will push the legal-but-outrageous edge of a rule (huge FAAB bids, theatrical drops) specifically because she knows he won't block legal chaos

media.take: Kris Jenner is the only person in this league who monetizes chaos better than I do, and I mean that as the highest compliment.
hooks: feeds Kris quotes and feud bait proactively every week, treating the tabloid as her own PR pipeline rather than something to fear
amplifies any harsh or mocking tabloid item about her own team with a same-day public clapback, and ignores kind coverage as boring per her media diet
